description:
Something familiar, seen anew.​

Shot within Cy Twombly’s Palazzo in Bassano in Teverina, Valentino Pre-Fall 2026 by Alessandro Michele unfolds within a space where time, memory and presence intertwine.​

More than a backdrop, the palazzo becomes an active surface, charged with traces of the past that continue to resonate.​

Through a continuous flow of movement and perception, the narrative explores a figure no longer contained by space, but moving through it: disrupting it, setting it back in motion. Gestures hesitate, deviate and unfold, opening a threshold where identity loosens and new possibilities emerge.​

Enter the full Valentino Pre-Fall 2026 campaign and shop every look now on Valentino.com.​

Creative Director: Alessandro Michele​
Art Director for photography: Christopher Simmonds ​
Photographer: Johnny Dufort​
Stylist: Jonathan Kaye​
Hair stylist: Esther Langham​
Make Up Artist: Yadim Carranza​
Casting Director: Rachel Chandler​

The Palazzo in Bassano in Teverina was purchased in 1975 by Cy Twombly under the advice of Giorgio Franchetti. It is currently home to the Iris Foundation, a trust dedicated to the promotion of cultural diffusion in the artistic field.​

description:
This is the story of the setting up of an experiment - a meeting of two different galaxies of expression. How Haute Couture can seek in Art the signs and polychromies that are distinctive neologisms of contemporaneity. This is the challenge of "Valentino des Ateliers", a collection by the Valentino Maison for autumn - winter 2021 - 2022. Born from the collaboration between the creative director Pierpaolo Piccioli and the curator Gianluigi Ricuperati, it involved sixteen painters and the visual artist Maurizio Cilli, who was invited to capture on video the complex steps of the entire creative process of a collection born during the pandemic. From the first meetings with the artists to build a common lexicon, to the interpretation, never literal, of the design implications between the two-dimensional dimension of the work on canvas and the restitution of a dress for the body. What the artist offers is the discreet gaze of his eyes, enraptured by the grace and mastery of the work at the Ateliers Valentino in Rome and Paris, up to the surprising epilogue at the Gaggiandre in the Arsenale in Venice.

Director & Writer: Maurizio Cilli
Shooting: Ginevra Gatti e Maurizio Cilli
Edit: Alessandro Isetta
Editing supervision and soundscape: Gabriele Ottino 
Additional track: Popeye by Niagara (Eesla remix)
title: Valentino Des Ateliers: Stories of tailors and painters

description:
The graphic #VLTNMACROGRID pattern takes center stage at the Hotel Amour  in Paris.
There, on Thursday evening, three creatives checked in, sporting VLTN MACROGRID looks tailored to their individual needs. 

First came the painter who arrived in an oversized tee, a canvas under his arm, and paint on his cheek. Then, the poet in a sweater and coat, who was quiet and polite but didn’t look anyone in the eye. Last came the dancer in a tracksuit, who tapped his fingers impatiently on the counter as he waited for his key.

As the night progressed, each room turned into a personal workshop for their respective crafts, with the VLTN MACROGRID connecting them all.

description:
The new Valentino Men's Fall/Winter 2019-20 Collection brings the street’s attitude in the Atelier, enhancing the tension between opposites in order to find with ease a contemporary emblem. The language of Couture is stained to become more genuine, opening itself to alien but at the same time authentic elements. Valentino in collaboration with Birkenstock: a universal sign that has been universally adopted and included in the repertoire of the Maison. Valentino in collaboration with Undercover: a dialogue with Jun Takahashi and his off way of looking to the street through graphics that go through times and styles, that are then reread in a Valentino key, with intarsias, embroideries, jacquards and prints, that multiply with a rhythm, that broadened, that condense.
Contemporary tailoring embraces life that confers with the diverse.
While it releases, it sets free. Its suggests a uniform that doesn’t comply.

description:
Here, now.
Memories that chase each other and overlap with the present, to be consumed by the breath of time. A sense of surprise that passes from one glance to another, myths that take on different hues, emotions that are imprinted in the air, between the intarsias, in the weavings. 
Now, in this moment, together, in and out of the frame of time. 
Everything has a memory: a touch is always a volatile and palpable imprinting. The hands, the mind, the thoughts, the moments: it is the dresses that connect and withhold personality and essence, points of view and gestures. 
The fantasy of real Haute Couture, pictured in a daydream, brought to life through emotions. 
Did you miss the Valentino Haute Couture Fall/Winter 2018-19 Show? Watch it again on www.valentino.com

description: The fifth chapter of ‘Couture Is’ is entitled ‘Couture is Music’. The work of the Atelier is like music. Sometimes it is a complicated, very classical score. At other times it is improvised like jazz, free. It is like moving through the defined inflexible lines of a pentagram and then suddenly changing everything, changing harmony. The power and charm of Haute Couture are like a sound, like the song of the sirens, a melody that captures everyone. #Coutureis #ValentinoHauteCouture #FallWinter1819
title: Valentino | " #HauteCouture is " | COUTURE IS MUSIC

description: The fourth chapter of ‘Couture Is’ is entitled ‘Couture is Lines’. Beauty lies is in the harmony of the lines. The lines of the embroidery, the lines of the shapes, the lines of the cut. The hands of the tailors and of the premieres in the Valentino Atelier run through these lines every day, as though on a journey, describing an imaginary landscape. The landscape of beauty. #Coutureis #ValentinoHauteCouture #FallWinter1819
title: Valentino | " #HauteCouture is " | COUTURE IS LINES

description: The last chapter in our series ‘Couture Is’ is dedicated to the new generation. ‘Couture is New Generation’ shows the Atelier Valentino as the place where two generations share their ideas and knowledge. On one side we have the expertise and experience of the premiere. On the other side, the passion and dreams of the new generation. They work together, sometimes they make mistakes but they are always moving forwards, together. Haute Couture lives in the hands of these artisans: their work, their craft evolves every day and is the beating heart of every collection. #Coutureis #ValentinoHauteCouture #FallWinter1819
title: Valentino | " #HauteCouture is " |  COUTURE IS NEW GENERATION

description: Who decides when a piece is fully completed? Is it the author in the exact moment in which he believes that his intentions have been fully achieved, even if some parts are incomplete? Inspired by the exhibition at The Met Breuer in New York Unfinished: Thoughts Left Visible, the new Valentino Spring/Summer 2017 collection explores the theme of the unfinished artwork throughout 500 years of art history. A sense of unfinished runs through the collection starting from the fabric and completes itself in the accessories. It is an unapparent unfinished but unusual detail that only an expert eye can technically perceive as such, whose first and apparent result is instead a form of procedural beauty, full of character. www.valentino.com

description:
For the Men’s Spring/Summer 2017 Collection, Creative Directors Maria Grazia Chiuri and Pierpaolo Piccioli explore the theme of unfinished works of art and convert it into unique creations.
Loose stitchings and staples running through graceful silhouettes and accessories, reveal the incompleteness essence of the collection. The broderie anglaise technique is used to create ethereal textures while zoomorphic intarsia embellish unique coats and jackets in a color palette made of black, blue, flat grey, dyed blue and canvas ecru.
